title: Breezy Citrus Meadow

diffuser.notes: Add to a diffuser with water; run for 30–45 minutes in an open room.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each use; spray lightly on linens or air.

why_it_works: Lemon’s bright, uplifting citrus pairs with lavender’s calming floral to ease summer heat, while a hint of peppermint adds a cooling, fresh breeze that feels like a midday sigh.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
